title: nimbus-lite
brief: A free, framework-free AI chat UI kit in vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — open index.html and it runs, no build step or dependencies. It includes a full chat layout with sidebar, live token streaming with blinking caret, Markdown plus syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy buttons, a model picker, and light/dark themes with accent colors; it is front-end only, so you bring your own backend (OpenAI, Anthropic, or a local model). The maintainer sells a fuller Nimbus kit ($19) adding citations, reasoning blocks, tool-call chips, and attachments.
details: nimbus-lite (vojtasve-droid) is a free, framework-free AI chat UI kit written in vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with zero dependencies and no build step — open index.html and it runs. It provides a full chat layout (sidebar, conversation list, header, composer) with live token streaming and a blinking caret, Markdown message styling, syntax-highlighted code blocks with one-click copy, a model picker, typing indicator, message actions, and light/dark themes plus five accent colors recolorable through a single CSS variable, all responsive and keyboard-accessible. It is front-end only: you bring your own backend (OpenAI, Anthropic, a local model) and swap the demo streamer for a fetch call that appends tokens as they arrive. The free Lite version covers streaming, markdown, code blocks, and themes; the paid full kit ($19 via Gumroad) adds sources and citations, collapsible reasoning blocks, tool-call chips for agent apps, file and image attachments, error and retry states, docs, a commercial license, and updates. Free to use and modify in personal or commercial projects, just not to resell as-is.
